 Most recent Most popular Post published at 65 mins 65 mins 
 Arsenal 0-2 Lyon 
 Emily Fox tries to take matters into her own hands and goes for goal from 25 yards out, but the ball doesn't dip in time to find a way under the bar.
 0 0 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 CLOSE! published at 63 mins 63 mins 
 Arsenal 0-2 Lyon 
 Selma Bacha bends in a teasing ball and Marie Antoinette-Katota can't get enough purchase on the header to glance it towards goal.
 Far too easy for the French striker. She's got so much time and space in the Arsenal box.
 3 4 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 'Can't help wondering why Arsenal let McCabe go' published at 21:22 GMT 21:22 GMT 
 Arsenal 0-2 Lyon 
 Rachel Brown-Finnis 
Former England goalkeeper on BBC Three 
 Taylor Hinds has done alright tonight but on a night like tonight you can't help wondering why they let someone like Katie McCabe go.
 She was an integral part of Arsenal's DNA and make up and it's no surprise there has been a drop off in everything since she has gone.
 10 9 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 SUBSTITUTIONS published at 63 mins 63 mins 
 Arsenal 0-2 Lyon 
 A triple change for Arsenal.
 Kim Little, Olivia Smith and Smilla Holmberg are on.
 Kyra Cooney-Cross, Lisa Baum and Taylor Hinds are off.
 9 3 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 get involved Get Involved published at 21:20 GMT 21:20 GMT 
 Click 'Get Involved' on this page to have your say 
 Image source, PA Media Arsenal have well and truly gone backwards this season - some shocking defending tonight.
 Mark, Nuneaton 
 35 9 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 61 mins 61 mins 
 Arsenal 0-2 Lyon 
 Just as Arsenal looked to be finding a foothold in the game, Lyon hit them with a suckerpunch. 
 Renee Slegers is readying some changes for the Gunners.
 8 5 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 21:18 GMT 21:18 GMT 
 Arsenal 0-2 Lyon 
 Emma Sanders 
BBC Sport women’s football news reporter at Meadow Park 
 Image source, Reuters Melchie Dumornay is one of the best players in the world and it's in those moments she shows it. 
 Marie-Antoinette Katoto did so well to tee her up and then it's just pure class from Dumornay. The Lyon bench in front of us were roaring in celebration and jumped up on their feet. 
 You do feel that could be game over. Remember, Lyon haven't conceded a goal in the Champions League this season, let alone two.
 7 7 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 YELLOW CARD published at 21:18 GMT 21:18 GMT 
 Arsenal 0-2 Lyon 
 Lisa Baum goes into the book for a late challenge on Marie-Antoinette Katoto.
 4 9 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 'Deadly Dumornay' published at 21:17 GMT 21:17 GMT 
 Arsenal 0-2 Lyon 
 Rachel Brown-Finnis 
Former England goalkeeper on BBC Three 
 It's pretty unforgiveable [defending] from Arsenal.
 There's no taking away from the power that Melchie Dumornay gets on that.
 Misa Rodriguez is not ever saving that.
 Deadly Dumornay.
 14 9 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 GOAL - Arsenal 0-2 Lyon published at 21:15 GMT 21:15 GMT 
 Melchie Dumornay (57 mins) 
 Image source, Getty Images What a hit!
 It looks like Marie-Antoinette Katoto has held onto the ball for too long before she lays it off for Melchie Dumornay , but the Haiti striker shows her quality by cutting outside and lashing the ball into the roof of the net.
 59 68 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 CLOSE! published at 21:14 GMT 21:14 GMT 
 Arsenal 0-1 Lyon 
 Vicki Becho fizzes in a dangerous cross, but neither Tabitha Chawinga or Marie-Antoinette Katoto can get a head on it to nod towards goal.
 The ball eventually trickles to Damaris Egurrola on the edge of the area and she lets rip, drilling the strike wide.
 5 7 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 'The crowd are starting to make some noise' published at 21:11 GMT 21:11 GMT 
 Arsenal 0-1 Lyon 
 Rachel Brown-Finnis 
Former England goalkeeper on BBC Three 
 Image source, Getty Images Arsenal want their fans to be singing at a noisy Borehamwood.
 The crowd are starting to make some noise.
 You feel a bit of a swell of confidence for Arsenal.
 21 19 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 52 mins 52 mins 
 Arsenal 0-1 Lyon 
 This is the best spell Arsenal have had all game. Whatever Renee Slegers tweaked at half-time seems to be working.
 Alessia Russo tries her luck with an angled strike, but Caitlin Foord is in the way and Lyon clear.
 5 5 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 21:09 GMT 21:09 GMT 
 Arsenal 0-1 Lyon 
 Emma Sanders 
BBC Sport women’s football news reporter at Meadow Park 
 The lineswoman has a broken flag! They have just had to replace it. It was a quick changeover to be fair. Get them in the relay team!
 20 6 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 49 mins 49 mins 
 Arsenal 0-1 Lyon 
 Frida Maanum feeds in Caitlin Foord but a poor touch lets her down and the ball trickles out for a Lyon goal-kick.
 Better from Arsenal, that.
 17 9 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 46 mins 46 mins 
 Arsenal 0-1 Lyon 
 Tabitha Chawinga holds off both Emily Fox and Leah Williamson, but Misa Rodriguez does well to rush off her line and smother the effort.
 An early Lyon goal in this second half could really kill any glimmer of Arsenal hope.
 10 6 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 KICK-OFF published at 21:03 GMT 21:03 GMT 
 Arsenal 0-1 Lyon 
 We're back under way.
 Can Arsenal get a grip of this game?
 19 14 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 21:01 GMT 21:01 GMT 
 HT: Arsenal 0-1 Lyon 
 Ellen White 
Former England striker on BBC Three 
 There are so many bodies in the box with Lyon - they are constantly attacking with so much precision.
 They are so good at getting back as well.
 14 8 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 get involved Get Involved published at 21:00 GMT 21:00 GMT 
 Click 'Get Involved' on this page to have your say 
 Not going to lie, I'm very disappointed in Arsenal. I expect more from them.
 William, London 
 42 15 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing

 HT: Arsenal 0-1 Lyon 
 Fran Kirby 
Former England forward on BBC Three 
 Really impressed with Lily Yohannes - she is the one who is dictating play in this game so far.
